message.content:
Below is a **starter‑kit** you can copy‑paste into your own repo and grow as you wish.  
It’s written in **Python 3.11+**, uses **FastAPI** for the REST layer, **SQLAlchemy** for persistence, and **PostgreSQL** as the backing store.  

Why this stack?

| Layer | Why |
|-------|-----|
| `fastapi` | Modern async framework → great performance & auto‑docs (`/openapi.json`, `/docs`) |
| `sqlalchemy[asyncio]` | Full ORM support – easy migrations, relationships, eager loading |
| `psycopg2-binary` | PostgreSQL driver (recommended for production) |
| `pydantic` | Data validation / serialization (built‑in with FastAPI) |
| `httpx` | Async HTTP client – used when calling third‑party services such as Open‑Meteo |

> ⚠️ *This is only a “boilerplate” – real deployments will require proper secrets handling, auth, rate limiting, monitoring, CI/CD pipelines, etc.*

---

## Project layout

```
tms/
├── app/
│   ├─ __init__.py
│   ├─ config.py          # Settings (env vars)
│   ├─ db.py              # DB engine/session maker
│   ├─ models.py          # SQLAlchemy tables
│   ├─ schemas.py         # Pydantic DTOs
│   ├─ crud.py            # CRUD helpers
│   ├─ routers/
│   │   ├─ __init__.py
│   │   ├─ vehicles.py
│   │   ├─ drivers.py
│   │   └─ shipments.py
│   ├─ utils/
│   │   ├─ routing.py      # Route optimisation stub
│   │   └─ weather.py      # Calls Open‑Meteo
│   └─ main.py             # FastAPI entry point
└── requirements.txt
```

Feel free to add more subpackages (`notifications`, `billing`, …).

---

### 1️⃣ Configuration (`app/config.py`)

```python
from pydantic import BaseSettings, Field


class Settings(BaseSettings):
    DATABASE_URL: str = Field(..., env="DATABASE_URL")
    OPEN_METEO_API_KEY: str | None = Field(None, env="OPEN_METEO_API_KEY")  # optional
    LOG_LEVEL: str = Field("info", env="LOG_LEVEL")

    class Config:
        case_sensitive = False
        env_file = ".env"
        env_file_encoding = "utf-8"


settings = Settings()
```

Create `.env`:

```
DATABASE_URL=postgresql://user:pass@localhost/tms_db
OPEN_METEO_API_KEY=
LOG_LEVEL=debug
```

---

### 2️⃣ Database connection (`app/db.py`)

```python
import asyncio
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import (
    create_async_engine,
    AsyncSession,
    async_sessionmaker,
)
from .config import settings

engine = create_async_engine(settings.DATABASE_URL, echo=False, future=True)
AsyncSessionLocal = async_sessionmaker(engine, expire_on_commit=False)


async def init_models():
    """Run once at startup to create all tables."""
    async with engine.begin() as conn:
        await conn.run_sync(SQLBase.metadata.create_all)
```

Add `SQLBase` base class later.

### 3️⃣ Models (`app/models.py`)

```python
from datetime import datetime
from typing import Optional

from sqlalchemy import Column, Integer, String, Float, ForeignKey, DateTime, Boolean
from sqlalchemy.orm import relationship, declarative_base

SQLBase = declarative_base()


class Vehicle(SQLBase):
    __tablename__ = "vehicles"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    vin = Column(String(20), unique=True, nullable=False, index=True)
    make = Column(String(50))
    model = Column(String(50))
    year = Column(Integer)
    capacity_tons = Column(Float)
    status = Column(Boolean, default=True)  # active/inactive

    assignments = relationship(
        "Shipment",
        back_populates="vehicle",
        cascade="all, delete-orphan",
    )


class Driver(SQLBase):
    __tablename__ = "drivers"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    first_name = Column(String(30))
    last_name = Column(String(30))
    license_number = Column(String(15), unique=True, index=True)
    phone = Column(String(20))

    assignments = relationship(
        "Shipment",
        back_populates="driver",
        cascade="all, delete-orphan",
    )


class Shipment(SQLBase):
    __tablename__ = "shipments"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    description = Column(String(200))
    pickup_latitude = Column(Float, nullable=False)
    pickup_longitude = Column(Float, nullable=False)
    delivery_latitude = Column(Float, nullable=False)
    delivery_longitude = Column(Float, nullable=False)
    weight_kg = Column(Float, nullable=False)
    scheduled_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)
    completed_at = Column(DateTime, nullable=True)

    vehicle_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey("vehicles.id"))
    driver_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey("drivers.id"))

    vehicle = relationship("Vehicle", back_populates="assignments")
    driver = relationship("Driver", back_populates="assignments")
```

### 4️⃣ Schemas (`app/schemas.py`)

Pydantic models mirror the public contract of each resource.

```python
from datetime import datetime
from typing import Optional

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field, PositiveFloat, constr


class VehicleBase(BaseModel):
    vin: constr(min_length=5, max_length=20)
    make: Optional[str]
    model: Optional[str]
    year: Optional[int]
    capacity_tons: Optional[PositiveFloat]


class VehicleCreate(VehicleBase):
    pass


class VehicleRead(VehicleBase):
    id: int
    status: bool

    class Config:
        orm_mode = True


class DriverBase(BaseModel):
    first_name: str
    last_name: str
    license_number: constr(max_length=15)
    phone: Optional[str]


class DriverCreate(DriverBase):
    pass


class DriverRead(DriverBase):
    id: int

    class Config:
        orm_mode = True


class ShipmentBase(BaseModel):
    description: Optional[str]
    pickup_latitude: float
    pickup_longitude: float
    delivery_latitude: float
    delivery_longitude: float
    weight_kg: PositiveFloat
    scheduled_at: Optional[datetime] = None


class ShipmentCreate(ShipmentBase):
    vehicle_id: Optional[int]
    driver_id: Optional[int]


class ShipmentRead(ShipmentBase):
    id: int
    completed_at: Optional[datetime]
    vehicle: Optional[VehicleRead]
    driver: Optional[DriverRead]

    class Config:
        orm_mode = True
```

### 5️⃣ CRUD utilities (`app/crud.py`)

A thin wrapper around SQLAlchemy queries so router files stay clean.

```python
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Sequence, Tuple

from fastapi.encoders import jsonable_encoder
from sqlalchemy.exc import NoResultFound
from sqlalchemy.future import select
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from .models import Vehicle, Driver, Shipment
from .schemas import (
    VehicleCreate,
    DriverCreate,
    ShipmentCreate,
    VehicleRead,
    DriverRead,
    ShipmentRead,
)


def _dict_to_model(model_cls, obj_dict: dict[Any]) -> Any:
    return model_cls(**obj_dict)


async def get_vehicle(db: AsyncSession, *, vid: int) -> Vehicle:
    result = await db.execute(select(Vehicle).where(Vehicle.id == vid))
    if not (veh := result.scalar_one_or_none()):
        raise NoResultFound(f"No vehicle found with id={vid}")
    return veh


async def list_vehicles(db: AsyncSession, skip: int = 0, limit: int = 100) -> List[Vehicle]:
    res = await db.execute(select(Vehicle).offset(skip).limit(limit))
    return res.scalars().all()


async def create_vehicle(db: AsyncSession, v_in: VehicleCreate) -> Vehicle:
    veh_obj = Vehicle(**v_in.dict())
    db.add(veh_obj)
    await db.commit()
    await db.refresh(veh_obj)
    return veh_obj


# Similar helper patterns for Driver and Shipment follow...
# For brevity, only vehicle helpers shown here.
```

### 6️⃣ Weather utility (`app/utils/weather.py`)

Uses the supplied `requests_get` function to fetch current conditions from Open‑Meteo.

```python
import math
from typing import Awaitable, Callable

import httpx
from ..config import settings

BASE_WEATHER_URL = "https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast"


async def get_current_weather(lat: float, lon: float) -> dict:
    """
    Return minimal JSON containing temperature, wind speed, precipitation probability.
    """
    params = {
        "latitude": lat,
        "longitude": lon,
        "current_weather": True,
        "timezone": "auto",
    }
    async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=settings.TIMEOUT) as client:
        resp = await client.get(BASE_WEATHER_URL, params=params)
        resp.raise_for_status()
        return resp.json()["current_weather"]


def haversine_distance(a_lat: float, a_lon: float, b_lat: float, b_lon: float) -> float:
    """
    Returns distance between two points on Earth in kilometers.
    """
    R = 6371.0  # km
    phi_a, lambda_a = map(math.radians, [a_lat, a_lon])
    phi_b, lambda_b = map(math.radians, [b_lat, b_lon])

    dphi = phi_b - phi_a
    dlambda = lambda_b - lambda_a

    a_val = math.sin(dphi / 2)**2 + math.cos(phi_a) * math.cos(phi_b) * math.sin(dlambda / 2)**2
    c = 2 * math.atan2(math.sqrt(a_val), math.sqrt(1 - a_val))
    return R * c
```

*Tip:* In production you’d cache results per coordinate block because weather changes slowly relative to truck movements.

### 7️⃣ Routing logic (`app/utils/routing.py`)

Very simple heuristic: pick nearest available vehicle, then compute ETA based on straight‑line distance and average speed (~80 km/h). Replace with a full graph search (OSRM, GraphHopper…) when ready.

```python
from collections import namedtuple
from typing import Iterable, Optional

from ..utils.weather import haversine_distance

AverageSpeedKmh = 80.0

RouteInfo = namedtuple("RouteInfo", ["distance_km", "eta_minutes"])

def estimate_route(pickup: tuple[float, float], dropoff: tuple[float, float]) -> RouteInfo:
    dist = haversine_distance(*pickup, *dropoff)
    eta_min = (dist / AverageSpeedKmh) * 60
    return RouteInfo(distance_km=round(dist, 1), eta_minutes=int(round(eta_min)))
```

### 8️⃣ Routers

#### Vehicles (`app/routers/vehicles.py`)

```python
from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, status
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from ...db import AsyncSessionLocal
from ...crud import create_vehicle, get_vehicle, list_vehicles
from ...schemas import VehicleCreate, VehicleRead

router = APIRouter(prefix="/vehicles", tags=["Vehicles"])


async def get_db() -> AsyncSession:
    async with AsyncSessionLocal() as session:
        yield session


@router.post("/", response_model=VehicleRead, status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
async def api_create_vehicle(v_in: VehicleCreate, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db)):
    try:
        return await create_vehicle(db, v_in)
    except Exception as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(exc))


@router.get("/{vid}", response_model=VehicleRead)
async def api_read_vehicle(vid: int, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db)):
    return await get_vehicle(db, vid=vid)


@router.get("/")
async def api_list_vehicles(skip: int = 0, limit: int = 25, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db)):
    return await list_vehicles(db, skip=skip, limit=limit)
```

#### Drivers (`app/routers/drivers.py`)
Same pattern—CRUD plus assignment endpoint.

#### Shipments (`app/routers/shipments.py`)

...

@router.post("/", response_model=ShipmentRead, status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
async def api_create_shipment(ship_in: ShipmentCreate, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db)):
    shipment = await create_shipment(db, ship_in)
    # Auto‑route estimation
    route_info = estimate_route(
        (shipment.pickup_latitude, shipment.pickup_longitude),
        (shipment.delivery_latitude, shipment.delivery_longitude),
    )
    # Optionally enrich payload with ETA
    shipment_data = {**ship_in.model_dump(), "estimated_eta_mins": route_info.eta_minutes}
    # Persist extra fields if desired…
    return shipment

### 9️⃣ Main application (`app/main.py`)

```python
import logging

from fastapi import FastAPI
from starlette.middleware.cors import CORSMiddleware

from .config import settings
from .db import init_models
from .routers import vehicles, drivers, shipments

logging.basicConfig(level=getattr(logging, settings.LOG_LEVEL.upper()))

app = FastAPI(title="Trucking TMS Demo", version="0.1.0")


@app.on_event("startup")
async def startup_event():
    await init_models()


origins = [
    "*",  # Adjust for prod!
]

app.add_middleware(CORSMiddleware, allow_origins=origins, allow_methods=["*"], allow_headers=["*"])

app.include_router(vehicles.router)
app.include_router(drivers.router)
app.include_router(shipments.router)
```

Running locally:

```bash
uvicorn app.main:app --reload
```

Open <http://127.0.0.1:8000/docs> to see Swagger UI automatically generated.
